items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: The interviewer introduces Harold to the interviewee ('Here's Harold... Remember who that?'), and the interviewee does not claim any prior personal or professional relationship with him.

ctx.x: I know when I was a young man, they used to be right there on Main Street, you know. Uh-huh. And I thought Teo had the Norella that was born and raised here myself.

Probably was. Yeah, I don't know. That's a Spanish name, you know. Maybe his people came from Mexico. Uh-huh. They might have, that's right. Or he might have gone back there to study for a year or something. Sure. And you never know. He did. He was a great musician. Come here. Here we go. Here's Harold. He didn't have it by him. Hello, can I have him? He's just telling us. Uh, this is Harold, Adrian. Remember who that? How do you feel? How you feeling? I'm fine, I'm fine too. It's fine, my boss. Uh, I wanna, uh,…

You just started playing yourself? No, I, I taken a few lessons in school out in Virginia, you see. Wow. And when I came, I used to play a violin. But, uh, after the clarinet, I played a guy in our band. I resumed the clarinet, you see. Uh-huh. And I put the violin down. Oh, yeah. What was this, Virginia? I went to school out in Virginia. Where is this? Rock Castle, Virginia. About 40 miles from Richmond.
